description: Training output_dir must use absolute path pointing to data disk (/root/autodl-tmp/), never relative path that resolves to root partition
type: feedback
---

Training output_dir must be an absolute path on the data disk (e.g. `/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/<exp_id>/`). Relative paths resolve to the root partition which has only 30GB and fills up during checkpoint saving.

**Why:** Standard 15% GRPO failed 3 times: v1 data disk full (fixable), v2 relative model_path treated as HF ID, v3 trained successfully but checkpoint saved to root partition (30GB) which was already near full — optimizer state write corrupted. A concurrent cleanup worker then moved the checkpoint, breaking eval paths.

**How to apply:** When constructing submit_training_job commands:
1. `--model_path` = absolute path on data disk (e.g. `/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_standard_15`)
2. `--output_dir` = absolute path on data disk (e.g. `/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/grpo_standard_15_seed123_v4`)
3. Always add `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1` to prevent network fallback
4. Never run disk cleanup while checkpoints are still needed by pending evals
